title: LIVEPERSON INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: LivePerson, Inc. entered into a Merger Agreement with SoundHound AI, Inc. on April 21, 2026, whereby SoundHound will acquire LivePerson through a stock-for-stock merger. LivePerson stockholders will receive shares of SoundHound Class A common stock as merger consideration, subject to cash adjustments and price collaring provisions.
key_points: LivePerson (LPSN) to merge with SoundHound AI, with LivePerson becoming an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of SoundHound
Aggregate Consideration Amount is $42,784,532.64, subject to adjustment for LivePerson's cash position
Merger subject to $74 million minimum cash requirement (or $71 million if closing occurs in July)
SoundHound Closing Stock Price collared between $7 and $12 per share for purposes of calculating merger consideration
The merger is intended to be treated as a taxable transaction for U.S. federal income tax purposes
Certain in-the-money options to purchase LivePerson Common Stock will be converted into cash or SoundHound options
